_comment: US4). No Epoch-specific code: every key below is a generic permit_ingest.py
option. state_from pulls the state out of the street address; strip_regex
drops Epoch's confidence tags from the owner; match_projects holds any
campus that matches a tracked project (data/project_key_map.csv) out of
the baseline, so a tracked project, possibly an opposed one, never enters
it a second time as an unopposed comparable.

state_from accepts a two-letter code or a full state name at the end of the address, before an optional ZIP, ', USA' or ', <Name> County'; a capture that names no US state (a street suffix like NW) is rejected, never guessed.
attribution: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers, https://epoch.ai/data/data-centers, licensed CC-BY 4.0
sampling_note: Epoch covers frontier-scale AI campuses only (about 90 worldwide). Rows are a sample of the very largest campuses, never of data centers in general; any comparison using them must say so. announced_date is Epoch's earliest dated observation of the site, a bound on the announcement.
